text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, we gather in the gym for an
announcement from Mejiro
McQueen on
behalf of her family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Dear students and esteemed trainers. It is
my pleasure to bring you an

announcement from the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In the near future, we will be hosting a
party to help foster exchange and
camaraderie. There will be no dress code,
so feel free to come as
you are.

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Huh. So the Mejiro family's throwing a
casual party. It's cool how
they're always
running events for us. Are you gonna go?

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I'll see you there, then. Oh, by the
way—did you hear? A lot of folks
tried out
for Satono Diamond's trainer trials,
but...

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
They say nobody passed. Makes you
wonder what she'll do now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today's the day of the party. As I'm
walking around, I spot Satono
Diamond
and Kitasan Black playing a board game.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh? In reversi, you need to take the
edges or you'll lose! Are you
sure you want
to go there, Dia?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Mhm! Everyone says you'll lose if you
don't
get the corners, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's just a superstition! Jinx, curse...
whatever it be, I'll win and
prove it wrong!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Aw, here we go—you've found another jinx
to break! I know exactly
how this'll go...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Satono Diamond takes a
convincing win. Turns out the

mild-mannered young lady has an
unexpected side to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems whenever she encounters a jinx or
superstition, she's driven
to prove it wrong.
It's hard to nail down just what kind of
person she is, but I think—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Um, may I have a moment? I saw you the
other day, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You were watching me at the scrimmage,
right? Um... I'd like to ask
you something.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Is there a reason you didn't come to my
trainer trials? You seemed
interested, so I
thought you'd be there.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If I didn't pass muster in your eyes,
can I
ask why? Is it just that I lack
potential?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her the truth—while she has the
makings of an incredible racer, I'm just a
run-of-the-mill trainer.
It's a wide gap I'm not good enough
to cross.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: A wide gap? But that's not...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I can understand why you'd be
hesitant, but humility in excess
is only
self-deprecation.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, McQueen! ♪ Good evening. Thank
you for having us!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Good evening. I bid you welcome,
Satono—as well as your young
trainer
acquaintance. May I intrude upon your
conversation?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Satono's family does run a major
conglomerate, but I wouldn't say she's
difficult to approach. Her trainer trials
might have sounded
intimidating...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But that only means she's taking it
seriously.
Isn't that so, Satono?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right. My trainer has to be
someone I can entrust with my
dream—the
Satono family's dearest wish.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The Satono family isn't as historied as
others, but we have a deep
love for
Umamusume racing and want it to flourish.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We help with events, charity work, and
whatever else we can. But we're young
compared to the Mejiro family, and the
greatest contribution of all has always
been beyond us.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Producing a G1 race winner from our
family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Skilled racers are the lifeblood of our
sport. There is no greater
contribution one
can make than producing a renowned
racer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond has accepted the weight
of that grand ambition.
Through her trainer
trials, she hoped to find someone who
would bear it with her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The Satono Group isn't chasing status, but
a goal it's never been able
to grasp.
Isn't
that right, Satono?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Everything I do is to fulfill my
family's dream. So I'll exhaust
every option
to find someone capable of chasing it with
me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want your opinion as a trainer—what did
you think of my racing? That look in your
eyes when you were watching me—I can't
stop
thinking about it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She looks me in the eye with such
intensity, it feels as if my answer is
the
most important thing in the world to her
right now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It would be disrespectful to not be honest
with her. I start by praising
her incredible
talent, then move on to the areas I think
she could improve in.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Real competition? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh. I did, now that you mention it. I've
never been marked so hard
before—it was
difficult to run how I wanted.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
But I've raced against training partners
since I was little. I always told
them to
never hold back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I can see that.
It's common for those of our
status. Since we're in positions of power,
others hesitate to run aggressively
against us, even if they don't realize it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I-I see! I've never thought about it like
that. No wonder I felt so
hemmed in...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Worked up? No one's ever told me
that before. What do you
mean?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her what I saw. Around the halfway
mark, she needed to bide her time, but
she felt pressured to speed up by those
closing in on
her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She let herself get worked up. Under her
mild-mannered demeanor, she has a
natural competitiveness waiting to rear
its
head.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I do remember that! In that moment, my legs were itching to break ahead...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
But I regained my composure right after.
At least, I thought I did. To
think you still
noticed...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Just... who are you? Why were you able to
gleam so much about me
from a single
race?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That fascination let me see past her
family name and grasp who she
really was as a
runner, both her strengths and
weaknesses.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Nobody's... ever told me that before. Not
even the trainers at the
trial. But you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, what a stroke of luck. To think
you'd find such a promising
candidate at a
party.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Satono,
might I suggest holding a trial for
this trainer? I know the
Satono Group has
high standards, but—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You're hired.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You're hired! From now on... you're my
trainer! You're the exact
person I've been
looking for! So, you're hired!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Pardon?! Um, Satono?! Are you certain?
You must know how
momentous this
decision is for your family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Don't let your emotions carry you away! At
least go home and talk to
your—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No, I've made my decision. As much as I
respect you, McQueen, I
won't budge on
this.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My trainer is right here—nobody else will
do! Normally, I'd consult my
family first,
but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If diving in headfirst is ill-advised,
then it's just another jinx—which
means I have to
break it! No matter what anyone says,
you're my trainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I've decided, and that's that! You'll
accept, right? Right? Right?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her firm insistence is a stark contrast to
her usual mild-mannered self.
In the end,
she doesn't let me go until I agree to be
her trainer.
